speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly where you feel the pain, and does it radiate to your arm, jaw, or back? Have you experienced any shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea alongside the pain?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain feels like a tight squeezing sensation right in the center of my chest. It often shoots out to my left arm and sometimes up into my jaw, and I've noticed I get short of breath and start sweating when it happens, especially after I've been working hard. I haven't felt any nausea or vomiting, though. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.
